sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of Up And 4 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Byas Kumar Prasad,Suresh Kumar Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed to direct the Court below to decide the Case No. 189 of 2019 (State Vs. Raju Jaiswal and others) arising out of submission of charge sheet dated 26.07.2019 in Case Crime No. 20 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Kandwa, District- Chandauli, pending before the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division/F.T.C.-I), Chandauli within stipulated time.
Expeditious disposal of a case is the right of every litigant and it is expected from every Court to endeavour to dispose of a case pending before it, expeditiously.
Learned A.G.A. for the State has no objection in this regard.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submission made by learned counsel for the applicant, it is expedient to direct the court concerned to make its endeavour to decide the aforesaid case as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties, in accordance with law, if there is no other legal impediment.
With the aforesaid directions, the application is disposed of.
